narrative.overview: PUP PAP AI pairs a warm, approachable Cream Paper default workspace (#EDE6D6) with a Minimalist Obsidian dark studio (#0F0F12). Designed for Thai e-commerce sellers and affiliate creators of all ages, the interface favors crisp 1.5px structural borders, high-contrast Thai typography, and unmistakable action buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-theme architecture: Warm Cream Paper default + Obsidian Studio dark toggle.
Tactile 1.5px solid structural borders with 20px card radii.
Strict WCAG AA contrast floor (>= 4.5:1) and Thai-friendly typography floor (>= 12px labels, >= 14px body copy).

rules.name: The High-Contrast Badge Rule
rules.body: Semantic pills on light/cream backgrounds must use deep text tokens (text-amber-800, text-emerald-800) rather than mid-tone 600 shades, and solid green buttons must use bg-emerald-700 with white text to guarantee >= 5.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.

rules.name: The 12px/14px Thai Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: No UI badge, tag, or caption may render below 12px (text-xs), and no multi-word description or paragraph over 60 characters may render below 14px (text-sm).

dos: Do use text-xs (12px) as the minimum size for all badges, tags, and metadata labels, and text-sm (14px) for all card and lesson descriptions.
Do flatten multi-column steps or value propositions inside .puppap-card using divide-y / divide-x divide-[var(--border-light)] instead of nested bordered cards.
Do use typographic kickers above h1 instead of pill-shaped eyebrow chips.
donts: Don't nest a bordered/rounded card container inside another .puppap-card.
Don't use AI-slop purple/violet gradients (from-purple-600, bg-clip-text gradient headings).
Don't use animate-pulse on static status dots or animate-bounce on loading indicators.
